units.zh: 天順元年
units.en: The first year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year one.

units.zh: 天順元年春正月壬午，昧爽，武清侯石亨，都督張輗、張軏，左都御史楊善，副 都御史徐有貞，太監曹吉祥以兵迎帝於南宮，御奉天門，朝百官。
units.en: In the first month of spring in Tianshun one, at first light on renwu, Shi Heng, Marquis of Wuqing, Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, regional commanders, Yang Shan, left censor-in-chief, Xu Youzhen, vice censor-in-chief, and the eunuch Cao Jixiang led troops to bring the Emperor out of the Southern Palace; he took the throne at Fengtian Gate and received the whole bureaucracy in audience.
units.literal: In spring of the first year, first month, on the day renwu, at gray dawn, Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng, Regional Commanders Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Shan, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and Eunuch Cao Jixiang with troops welcomed the Emperor from the Southern Palace, held court at Fengtian Gate, and the hundred officials attended.

units.zh: 徐有貞以原官兼翰 林學士，入閣預機務。
units.en: Xu Youzhen kept his prior post and was also made Hanlin academician; he entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate state secrets.
units.literal: Xu Youzhen, in his original office, was concurrently made a Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 日中，御奉天殿即位。
units.en: At noon he formally ascended the throne in Fengtian Hall.
units.literal: At midday, he took the throne at Fengtian Hall.

units.zh: 下兵部尚書于謙、大學士王文錦衣衛獄 。
units.en: Minister of War Yu Qian and Grand Secretary Wang Wen were thrown into the Brocade Guard prison.
units.literal: Minister of War Yu Qian and Grand Secretary Wang Wen were sent to the Brocade Guard prison.

units.zh: 太常寺卿許彬、大理寺卿薛瑄為禮部侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。
units.en: Xu Bin, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Xue Xuan, chief minister of the Court of Judicial Review, were made vice ministers of rites and Hanlin academicians and joined the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xu Bin and Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Xue Xuan were made Vice Ministers of Rites concurrently serving as Hanlin academicians and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔赦天 下，改景泰八年為天順元年。
units.en: On bingxu an amnesty was proclaimed and the eighth year of Jingtai was declared the first year of Tianshun.
units.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm and changed Jingtai year eight to Tianshun year one.

units.zh: 論奪門迎復功，封石亨忠國公，張軏太平侯，張輗文安 伯，楊善興濟伯，曹吉祥嗣子欽都督同知。
units.en: Rewards were fixed for the Gate-Seizing restoration: Shi Heng became Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Yue, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Ni, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made vice commissioner-in-chief.
units.literal: Merit in the Gate-Seizing restoration was discussed and rewarded: Shi Heng was enfeoffed Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Yue, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Ni, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made Vice Commissioner-in-chief.

units.zh: 丁亥，殺于謙、王文，籍其家。
units.en: On dinghai Yu Qian and Wang Wen were put to death and their estates were seized.
units.literal: On the day dinghai, Yu Qian and Wang Wen were executed and their households were registered and confiscated.

units.zh: 陳循、江 淵、俞士悅謫戍，蕭鎡、商輅除名。
units.en: Chen Xun, Jiang Yuan, and Yu Shiyue were banished to the frontier; Xiao Zi and Shang Lu were expelled from office.
units.literal: Chen Xun, Jiang Yuan, and Yu Shiyue were demoted to frontier garrison service; Xiao Zi and Shang Lu were struck from the register.

units.zh: 己丑，復論奪門功，封孫鏜懷寧伯，董興海寧伯 ，欽天監正湯序禮部右侍郎，官舍旂軍晉級者凡三千餘人。
units.en: On jichou the court again ranked Gate-Seizing merit: Sun Tang was made Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Tang Xu, director of astronomy, vice minister of rites on the right; and more than three thousand clerks, bannermen, and camp soldiers were advanced in rank.
units.literal: On the day jichou, Gate-Seizing merit was again discussed: Sun Tang was enfeoffed Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Director of the Directorate of Astronomy Tang Xu, Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Rites; and banner troops, clerks, and garrison soldiers promoted in rank numbered more than three thousand in all.

units.zh: 辛卯，罷巡撫提督官。
units.en: On xinmao the posts of grand coordinator and military superintendent were abolished.
units.literal: On the day xinmao, grand coordinator and military superintendent posts were abolished.

units.zh: 壬 辰，榜于謙黨人示天下。
units.en: On renchen a public list named the members of Yu Qian's faction.
units.literal: On the day renchen, a list of Yu Qian's faction was posted to inform the realm.

units.zh: 甲午，殺昌平侯楊俊。
units.en: On jiawu Yang Jun, Marquis of Changping, was executed.
units.literal: On the day jiawu, Marquis of Changping Yang Jun was executed.

units.zh: 二月乙未朔，廢景泰帝為郕王。
units.en: On the new moon of the second month, yimao, Emperor Jingtai was degraded to Prince of Cheng.
units.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day yimao, the Jingtai Emperor was deposed as Prince of Cheng.

units.zh: 庚子 ，高穀致仕。
units.en: On gengzi Gao Gu resigned his post.
units.literal: On the day gengzi, Gao Gu retired from office.

units.zh: 湯序請除景泰年號，不許。
units.en: Tang Xu asked that the Jingtai reign name be struck; the throne refused.
units.literal: Tang Xu requested that the Jingtai reign title be abolished; this was not permitted.

units.zh: 癸卯，吏部侍郎李賢兼翰林學士，入閣預機 務。
units.en: On guimao Li Xian, vice minister of personnel, was also made Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: On the day guimao, Vice Minister of Personnel Li Xian was concurrently made a Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 殺都督范廣。
units.en: Regional Commander Fan Guang was put to death.
units.literal: Regional Commander Fan Guang was executed.

units.zh: 戊申，柳溥破廣西蠻。
units.en: On wushen Liu Pu routed the Guangxi tribes.
units.literal: On the day wushen, Liu Pu defeated the Guangxi tribes.

units.zh: 癸丑，郕王薨。
units.en: On guichou the Prince of Cheng died.
units.literal: On the day guichou, the Prince of Cheng died.

units.zh: 戊午，方瑛、石璞大破湖廣 苗。
units.en: On wuwu Fang Ying and Shi Pu shattered the Huguang Miao.
units.literal: On the day wuwu, Fang Ying and Shi Pu inflicted a great defeat on the Huguang Miao.

units.zh: 召璞還。
units.en: Shi Pu was recalled to court.
units.literal: Shi Pu was recalled.

units.zh: 壬戌，免南畿被災秋糧。
units.en: On renxu autumn tax grain was forgiven in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Circuit.
units.literal: On the day renxu, autumn grain tax in the Southern Metropolitan Circuit stricken by disaster was remitted.

units.zh: 三月己巳，復立長子見深為皇太子，封皇子見 潾為德王，見澍秀王，見澤崇王，見浚吉王。
units.en: In the third month, on jisi, the eldest son Zhu Jianshen was again named crown prince; Zhu Jianlin was enfeoffed Prince of De, Zhu Jianshu Prince of Xiu, Zhu Jianze Prince of Chong, and Zhu Jianjun Prince of Ji.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day jisi, the eldest son Jianshen was again established as Crown Prince; the princes Jianlin, Jianshu, Jianze, and Jianjun were enfeoffed as Prince of De, Prince of Xiu, Prince of Chong, and Prince of Ji.

units.zh: 癸酉，封徐有貞武功伯。
units.en: On guiyou Xu Youzhen was made Baron of Wugong.
units.literal: On the day guiyou, Xu Youzhen was enfeoffed Baron of Wugong.

units.zh: 乙亥，大賚文 武軍民。
units.en: On yihai the court lavished rewards on officials, troops, and people.
units.literal: On the day yihai, civil and military officials, soldiers, and commoners were greatly rewarded.

units.zh: 庚辰，賜黎淳等進士及第、出身有差。
units.en: On gengchen Li Chun and the other new jinshi were given court ranks according to degree.
units.literal: On the day gengchen, Li Chun and other metropolitan degree holders were granted investiture and appointment in varying ranks.

units.zh: 石亨為征虜副將軍，剿寇延綏。
units.en: Shi Heng was appointed deputy general for the punitive campaign in Yan-sui.
units.literal: Shi Heng was made Deputy General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians to suppress bandits in Yan-sui.

units.zh: 丁亥 ，振山東饑。
units.en: On dinghai relief was sent to famine-stricken Shandong.
units.literal: On the day dinghai, Shandong famine was relieved.

units.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，以災異數見求直言。
units.en: On the new moon of the fourth month of summer, jiawu, after repeated omens and disasters the throne called for blunt counsel.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the new moon day jiawu, because omens and disasters had repeatedly appeared, frank memorials were sought.

units.zh: 乙未，免浙江被災稅糧。
units.en: On yimao tax grain was remitted in disaster-hit Zhejiang.
units.literal: On the day yimao, tax grain in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.

units.zh: 丁酉，方瑛攻銅鼓 藕洞苗，悉平之。
units.en: On dingyou Fang Ying attacked the Tonggu and Oudong Miao and brought them all to submission.
units.literal: On the day dingyou, Fang Ying attacked the Tonggu and Oudong Miao and pacified them entirely.

units.zh: 丁未，錄囚。
units.en: On dingwei the court reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On the day dingwei, prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 癸丑，罷團營。
units.en: On guichou the regimented camps were disbanded.
units.literal: On the day guichou, the regimented camps were abolished.

units.zh: 乙卯，孛來寇寧夏，參將种興戰死。
units.en: On yimao Bolai struck Ningxia; Zhong Xing, regional vice commander, was killed in action.
units.literal: On the day yimao, Bolai raided Ningxia; Regional Vice Commander Zhong Xing died in battle.

units.zh: 五月辛未，安遠侯柳溥備宣、大邊。
units.en: In the fifth month, on xinwei, Liu Pu, Marquis of Anyuan, took charge of the Xuan and Datong frontier.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinwei, Marquis of Anyuan Liu Pu prepared the defenses of Xuan and Datong.

units.zh: 是月，以石亨言下御史楊瑄、張鵬獄。
units.en: That month, at Shi Heng's word, the censors Yang Xuan and Zhang Peng were thrown into prison.
units.literal: That month, on Shi Heng's accusation, Censor Yang Xuan and Zhang Peng were imprisoned.

units.zh: 六月甲午 ，下右都御史耿九疇、副都御史羅綺錦衣衛獄。
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiawu, Geng Jiuchou, right censor-in-chief, and Luo Qi, vice censor-in-chief, were imprisoned in the Brocade Guard.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, Right Censor-in-chief Geng Jiuchou and Vice Censor-in-chief Luo Qi were sent to the Brocade Guard prison.

units.zh: 己亥，下徐有貞、李賢錦衣衛獄。
units.en: On jihai Xu Youzhen and Li Xian were imprisoned in the Brocade Guard.
units.literal: On the day jihai, Xu Youzhen and Li Xian were sent to the Brocade Guard prison.

units.zh: 是 日，大風雨雹，壞奉天門鴟吻，敕修省。
units.en: That same day a storm of wind, rain, and hail shattered the roof ornaments of Fengtian Gate, and the Emperor ordered the court to examine itself and reform.
units.literal: That day, great wind, rain, and hail damaged the ridge ornaments of Fengtian Gate; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.

units.zh: 庚子，徐有貞、李賢、羅綺、耿九疇謫外任 ，楊瑄、張鵬戍邊。
units.en: On gengzi Xu Youzhen, Li Xian, Luo Qi, and Geng Jiuchou were banished to provincial posts; Yang Xuan and Zhang Peng were exiled to the frontier.
units.literal: On the day gengzi, Xu Youzhen, Li Xian, Luo Qi, and Geng Jiuchou were demoted to posts outside the capital; Yang Xuan and Zhang Peng were sent to frontier garrison service.

units.zh: 通政司參議兼侍講呂原入閣預機務。
units.en: Lu Yuan, participating administrator of the transmission office and lecturing reader, entered the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: Participating Administrator of the Transmission Office and Concurrent Lecturing Reader Lu Yuan entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 壬寅，薛瑄致仕。
units.en: On renyin Xue Xuan resigned.
units.literal: On the day renyin, Xue Xuan retired from office.

units.zh: 癸卯，修 撰岳正入閣預機務。
units.en: On guimao Compiler Yue Zheng entered the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: On the day guimao, Compiler Yue Zheng entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 甲辰，復李賢為吏部侍郎。
units.en: On jiachen Li Xian was restored as vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Xian was restored as Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 乙巳，巡撫貴州副都御史蔣琳坐于謙 黨棄市。
units.en: On yisi Jiang Lin, grand coordinator of Guizhou, was condemned as a Yu Qian partisan and executed in the marketplace.
units.literal: On the day yisi, Grand Coordinator of Guizhou and Vice Censor-in-chief Jiang Lin, as a member of Yu Qian's faction, was executed in the marketplace.

units.zh: 秋七月乙丑，復下徐有貞於獄。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, Xu Youzhen was imprisoned again.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day yichou, Xu Youzhen was again sent to prison.

units.zh: 丙寅，承天門災。
units.en: On bingyin Chengtian Gate burned down.
units.literal: On the day bingyin, Chengtian Gate was destroyed by fire.

units.zh: 丁卯，躬禱於南郊。
units.en: On dingmao the Emperor prayed in person at the Southern Suburb.
units.literal: On the day dingmao, he personally offered prayer at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 戊辰，敕 修省。
units.en: On wuchen the throne ordered austerity and reform.
units.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.

units.zh: 庚午，李賢復入閣。
units.en: On gengwu Li Xian returned to the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: On the day gengwu, Li Xian again entered the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 改許彬南京禮部侍郎。
units.en: Xu Bin was moved to vice minister of rites at Nanjing.
units.literal: Xu Bin was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites at Nanjing.

units.zh: 辛未，出岳正為欽州同知，尋下獄 ，謫戍。
units.en: On xinwei Yue Zheng was posted subprefectural magistrate of Qinzhou, then seized, imprisoned, and banished to the frontier.
units.literal: On the day xinwei, Yue Zheng was sent out as Subprefectural Magistrate of Qinzhou; soon he was imprisoned and demoted to frontier garrison service.

units.zh: 癸酉，大赦。
units.en: On guiyou a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On the day guiyou, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 癸未，放徐有貞於金齒。
units.en: On guiwei Xu Youzhen was exiled to Jinchi.
units.literal: On the day guiwei, Xu Youzhen was released to Jinchi.

units.zh: 辛卯，大賚諸邊軍士。
units.en: On xinmao the court lavished rewards on troops along the borders.
units.literal: On the day xinmao, frontier troops were greatly rewarded.

units.zh: 八月甲午，以 彗星屢見，躬禱於上帝。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jiawu, after repeated comets the Emperor prayed in person to Heaven.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiawu, because a comet had repeatedly been seen, he personally offered prayer to the Supreme Lord.

units.zh: 九月甲子，太常少卿彭時兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。
units.en: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Peng Shi, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was also made Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiazi, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Peng Shi was concurrently made a Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 冬十月丁酉，賜王振祭葬，立祠曰「旌忠」。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, Wang Zhen was given state funeral honors and a shrine named "Commending Loyalty."
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day dingyou, ceremonial burial was granted to Wang Zhen and a shrine was established titled "Commending Loyalty."

units.zh: 壬寅，徵江西處士吳與弼。
units.en: On renyin the Jiangxi scholar-recluse Wu Yubi was summoned to court.
units.literal: On the day renyin, the Jiangxi recluse Wu Yubi was summoned.

units.zh: 丙辰， 釋建文帝幼子文圭及其家屬，安置鳳陽。
units.en: On bingchen Wen Gui, the young son of Emperor Jianwen, and his kin were freed and settled at Fengyang.
units.literal: On the day bingchen, the young son of Emperor Jianwen, Wen Gui, and his household were released and settled at Fengyang.

units.zh: 十一月甲戌，廣西總兵官朱瑛討田州叛蠻。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Zhu Ying, supreme commander of Guangxi, marched against the rebel tribes of Tianzhou.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, Zhu Ying, supreme commander of Guangxi, campaigned against the rebel tribes of Tianzhou.

units.zh: 己丑，免山東被災夏稅。
units.en: On jichou summer tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Shandong.
units.literal: On the day jichou, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shandong was remitted.

units.zh: 十二月壬辰，封曹欽昭武伯。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on renchen, Cao Qin was made Baron of Zhaowu.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renchen, Cao Qin was enfeoffed Baron of Zhaowu.

units.zh: 辛丑，安遠侯柳溥充總兵官， 禦孛來於甘、涼。
units.en: On xinchou Liu Pu, Marquis of Anyuan, was made supreme commander to hold Bolai on the Gan and Liang frontier.
units.literal: On the day xinchou, Marquis of Anyuan Liu Pu was made supreme commander to resist Bolai in Gan and Liang.

units.zh: 是年，琉球中山、安南、暹羅、占城、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。
units.en: That year Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Siam, Champa, Hami, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
units.literal: That year, Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Siam, Champa, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順二年
units.en: The second year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year two.

units.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，兵部尚書陳汝言有罪下獄。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the second year, on xinyou, Chen Ruyan, minister of war, was imprisoned for misconduct.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, on the day xinyou, Minister of War Chen Ruyan, guilty of an offense, was imprisoned.

units.zh: 乙丑，享太廟。
units.en: On yichou the court sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On the day yichou, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 甲戌，大祀天地於 南郊。
units.en: On jiaxu the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: On the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 己卯，上皇太后尊號。
units.en: On jimao the Empress Dowager was given an elevated honorific title.
units.literal: On the day jimao, the honorific title of the Empress Dowager was elevated.

units.zh: 二月戊申，開雲南、福建、浙江銀場。
units.en: In the second month, on wushen, silver mines in Yunnan, Fujian, and Zhejiang were opened.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day wushen, silver mines in Yunnan, Fujian, and Zhejiang were opened.

units.zh: 中官市雲南珍寶 。
units.en: Palace eunuchs were sent to buy luxuries in Yunnan.
units.literal: Palace eunuchs purchased precious goods in Yunnan.

units.zh: 閏月己卯，瘞土木暴骸。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on jimao, the unburied dead of the Tumu disaster were interred.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jimao, the exposed corpses of the Tumu disaster were buried.

units.zh: 夏四月，復設巡撫官。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer the office of grand coordinator was restored.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, grand coordinator posts were reestablished.

units.zh: 五月壬寅，授處士吳與弼左諭德，辭不拜，尋送還鄉。
units.en: In the fifth month, on renyin, Wu Yubi was offered the post of left lecturing reader; he refused and was soon sent home.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renyin, the recluse Wu Yubi was appointed Left Lecturing Reader; he declined the appointment and was soon sent home.

units.zh: 秋七月癸卯，定遠伯石彪為平夷將軍，充總兵官，禦寇寧夏。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on guimao, Shi Biao, Baron of Dingyuan, was made general for the pacification of the Yi and supreme commander on the Ningxia front.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guimao, Baron of Dingyuan Shi Biao was made General for the Pacification of the Yi and supreme commander to resist the enemy in Ningxia.

units.zh: 八月戊辰，孛來寇 鎮番。
units.en: In the eighth month, on wuchen, Bolai raided Zhenfan.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, Bolai raided Zhenfan.

units.zh: 冬十月甲子，獵南海子。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, the Emperor hunted in the Southern Park.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day jiazi, he hunted at the Southern Park.

units.zh: 壬午，武平伯陳友為征夷將軍，充總兵官，剿寇寧夏。
units.en: On renwu Chen You, Baron of Wuping, was made general for the punitive campaign against the Yi and supreme commander in Ningxia.
units.literal: On the day renwu, Baron of Wuping Chen You was made General for the Punitive Campaign against the Yi and supreme commander to suppress bandits in Ningxia.

units.zh: 十一月甲寅，免山東秋糧。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, autumn tax grain was forgiven in Shandong.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiayin, autumn grain tax in Shandong was remitted.

units.zh: 是年，安南、烏斯藏、占城、哈密入貢。
units.en: That year Annam, U-Tsang, Champa, and Hami presented tribute.
units.literal: That year, Annam, U-Tsang, Champa, and Hami sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順三年
units.en: The third year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year three.

units.zh: 三年春正月乙未，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the third year, on yiwei, the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: In spring of the third year, first month, on the day yiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 甲辰，定遠伯石彪、彰武伯楊信敗孛來於安邊營，都督僉事周賢、都指揮李鑑戰死。
units.en: On jiachen Shi Biao, Baron of Dingyuan, and Yang Xin, Baron of Zhangwu, routed Bolai at Anbian Camp; Zhou Xian, commissioner-in-chief, and Li Jian, regional commander, were killed.
units.literal: On the day jiachen, Baron of Dingyuan Shi Biao and Baron of Zhangwu Yang Xin defeated Bolai at Anbian Camp; Commissioner-in-chief Zhou Xian and Regional Commander Li Jian died in battle.

units.zh: 進彪為侯。
units.en: Shi Biao was promoted to marquis.
units.literal: Biao was advanced to marquis.

units.zh: [1]二月丁卯，遣御史及中官採珠廣東。
units.en: [1] In the second month, on dingmao, censors and palace eunuchs were sent to Guangdong to collect pearls.
units.literal: [1] In the second month, on the day dingmao, censors and palace eunuchs were dispatched to gather pearls in Guangdong.

units.zh: 夏四月壬子，巡撫兩廣僉都御史葉盛破瀧水瑤。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on renzi, Ye Sheng, grand coordinator of the Two Guangs, defeated the Longshui Yao.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day renzi, Ye Sheng, Vice Censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of the Two Guangs, defeated the Longshui Yao.

units.zh: 己巳，南和侯方瑛克貴州苗。
units.en: On jisi Fang Ying, Marquis of Nanhe, subdued the Guizhou Miao.
units.literal: On the day jisi, Marquis of Nanhe Fang Ying conquered the Guizhou Miao.

units.zh: 六月辛酉，復命巡撫官以八月集京師議事。
units.en: In the sixth month, on xinyou, grand coordinators were again ordered to gather at court in the eighth month for council.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, an order again commanded grand coordinators to assemble at the capital in the eighth month for deliberation.

units.zh: 秋八月庚戌，石彪有罪，下錦衣衛獄。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengxu, Shi Biao was imprisoned in the Brocade Guard.
units.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day gengxu, Shi Biao, guilty of an offense, was sent to the Brocade Guard prison.

units.zh: 己未，禁文武大臣、給事中、御史、錦衣衛官往來交通，違者依鐵榜例論罪。
units.en: On jiwei the court forbade senior officials, supervising secretaries, censors, and Brocade Guard officers from private visits and collusion; offenders were punished under the Iron Plank precedent.
units.literal: On the day jiwei, civil and military grandees, supervising secretaries, censors, and Brocade Guard officers were forbidden to visit one another or exchange favors; violators were punished under the Iron Plank regulations.

units.zh: 乙亥，免湖廣被災秋糧。
units.en: On yihai autumn tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Huguang.
units.literal: On the day yihai, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.

units.zh: 冬十月己未，幸南海子。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day jiwei, he visited the Southern Park.

units.zh: 庚午，石亨以罪罷。
units.en: On gengwu Shi Heng was stripped of office for misconduct.
units.literal: On the day gengwu, Shi Heng was dismissed for an offense.

units.zh: 諸奪門冒功者許自首改正。
units.en: Men who had falsely claimed Gate-Seizing merit were allowed to confess and have their rewards adjusted.
units.literal: Those who had falsely claimed Gate-Seizing merit were permitted to confess and have their rewards corrected.

units.zh: 是月，命法司會廷臣，每歲霜降錄囚，後以為常。
units.en: That month the judiciary was ordered to join the court each Frost's Descent in the annual prison review, which thereafter became custom.
units.literal: That month, the legal offices were ordered to join court ministers in reviewing prisoners at Frost's Descent each year; this afterward became regular practice.

units.zh: 十一月癸巳，振湖廣饑。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on guisi, relief was sent to famine-stricken Huguang.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guisi, Huguang famine was relieved.

units.zh: 是年哈密、疏球中山、錫蘭山、滿剌加入貢。
units.en: That year Hami, Ryukyu Chuzan, Ceylon, and Malacca presented tribute.
units.literal: That year, Hami, Ryukyu Chuzan, Ceylon, and Malacca sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順四年
units.en: The fourth year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year four.

units.zh: 四年春正月丁亥，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on dinghai, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day dinghai, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 癸卯，石亨有罪下獄，尋死。
units.en: On guimao Shi Heng was jailed for misconduct and soon died in custody.
units.literal: On the day guimao, Shi Heng, guilty of an offense, was sent to prison; before long he died.

units.zh: 二月壬子，僮陷梧州。
units.en: In the second month, on renzi, Zhuang raiders seized Wuzhou.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day renzi, Zhuang bandits took Wuzhou.

units.zh: 丁卯，石彪棄市。
units.en: On dingmao Shi Biao was executed in the marketplace.
units.literal: On the day dingmao, Shi Biao was executed in the marketplace.

units.zh: 三月庚辰，賜王一夔等進士及第、出身有差。
units.en: In the third month, on gengchen, Wang Yikui and others received jinshi degrees with distinctions of rank and origin.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day gengchen, Wang Yikui and others were granted jinshi with distinctions of first rank, origin, and so forth.

units.zh: 戊戌，免南畿被災秋糧。
units.en: On wuxu autumn grain tax was forgiven in the disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region.
units.literal: On the day wuxu, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.

units.zh: 夏四月己酉，分遣內臣督浙江、雲南、福建、四川銀課。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, palace eunuchs were sent out separately to oversee silver levies in Zhejiang, Yunnan, Fujian, and Sichuan.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day jiyou, eunuchs were dispatched in separate missions to supervise silver levies in Zhejiang, Yunnan, Fujian, and Sichuan.

units.zh: 壬子，襄王瞻墡來朝。
units.en: On renzi the Prince of Xiang, Zhu Zhanshan, came to court.
units.literal: On the day renzi, the Prince of Xiang, Zhu Zhanshan, came to court.

units.zh: 五月壬午，免畿內、浙江被災秋糧。
units.en: In the fifth month, on renwu, autumn grain tax was remitted in the capital region and in disaster-hit Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renwu, autumn grain tax in the metropolitan districts and Zhejiang where disaster had struck was remitted.

units.zh: 己亥，罷中官督蘇、杭織造。
units.en: On jihai the court ended palace eunuch supervision of Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving.
units.literal: On the day jihai, the supervision of Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving by palace eunuchs was abolished.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，免湖廣被災稅糧。
units.en: In the sixth month, on guihai, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Huguang.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guihai, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.

units.zh: 秋七月乙亥朔，日有食之。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on the new moon yihai, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the new moon day yihai, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 辛卯，自五月雨至是月，淮水決，沒軍民田廬，遣使振卹。
units.en: On xinmao, after rain from the fifth month through this month, the Huai burst its banks and drowned soldiers' and civilians' fields and homes; envoys were sent with relief.
units.literal: On the day xinmao, rain had fallen continuously from the fifth month until this month; the Huai River burst its banks and drowned the fields and dwellings of soldiers and civilians; envoys were dispatched with relief.

units.zh: 八月甲子，孛來三道入寇，大同總兵官李文、宣府總兵官楊能禦之。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jiazi, Bolai invaded on three routes; Li Wen, supreme commander at Datong, and Yang Neng, supreme commander at Xuanfu, met him in battle.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, Bolai invaded by three routes; Li Wen, supreme commander at Datong, and Yang Neng, supreme commander at Xuanfu, resisted him.

units.zh: 癸酉，孛來入雁門，掠忻、代、朔諸州。
units.en: On guiyou Bolai entered Yanmen and looted Xin, Dai, Shuo, and neighboring prefectures.
units.literal: On the day guiyou, Bolai entered Yanmen and plundered the prefectures of Xin, Dai, and Shuo.

units.zh: 九月庚辰，孛來圍大同右衛。
units.en: In the ninth month, on gengchen, Bolai besieged Datong Right Guard.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengchen, Bolai besieged Datong Right Guard.

units.zh: 庚寅，撫寧伯朱永，都督白玉、鮑政備宣府邊。
units.en: On gengyin Zhu Yong, Baron of Funing, and commissioners Bai Yu and Bao Zheng took post on the Xuanfu frontier.
units.literal: On the day gengyin, Zhu Yong, Baron of Funing, and the military commissioners Bai Yu and Bao Zheng prepared defenses on the Xuanfu frontier.

units.zh: 甲午，免江西被災秋糧。
units.en: On jiawu autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-hit Jiangxi.
units.literal: On the day jiawu, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted.

units.zh: 冬十月甲子，閱京營將領騎射於西苑。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, generals of the metropolitan camp were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day jiazi, metropolitan camp generals were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.

units.zh: 戊辰，幸南海子。
units.en: On wuchen the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
units.literal: On the day wuchen, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

units.zh: 十一月丁酉，閱隨操武臣騎射於西苑。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on dingyou, officers on field drill were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingyou, military officers on active drill were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.

units.zh: 閏月己未，幸鄭村壩，閱甲仗軍馬。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on jiwei, the Emperor went to Zheng Village Dam and inspected arms, armor, troops, and horses.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, the Emperor visited Zheng Village Dam and inspected armor, weapons, troops, and horses.

units.zh: 是年，疏球中山、安南、占城、爪哇、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。
units.en: That year embassies came from Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Champa, Java, Hami, and U-Tsang.
units.literal: That year, Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Champa, Java, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順五年
units.en: The fifth year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year five.

units.zh: 五年春正月庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on gengxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day gengxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 二月己卯，免山東被災稅糧。
units.en: In the second month, on jimao, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Shandong.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day jimao, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shandong was remitted.

units.zh: 丙申，都督僉事顏彪為征夷將軍，充總兵官，討兩廣瑤賊。
units.en: On bingshen Yan Biao, vice commissioner-in-chief, was made Pacification General for the Yi and supreme commander to suppress Yao rebels in the two Guang.
units.literal: On the day bingshen, Yan Biao, Vice Commissioner-in-chief, was made Pacification General for the Yi and served as supreme commander to campaign against Yao bandits in the two Guang.

units.zh: 三月壬子，免蘇、松、常、鎮被災稅糧。
units.en: In the third month, on renzi, tax grain was remitted in disaster districts of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day renzi, tax grain in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang where disaster had struck was remitted.

units.zh: 甲寅，湖廣、貴州總兵官李震會廣西軍剿瑤、僮，悉破之。
units.en: On jiayin Li Zhen, supreme commander in Huguang and Guizhou, joined Guangxi forces against Yao and Zhuang rebels and broke them completely.
units.literal: On the day jiayin, Li Zhen, supreme commander of Huguang and Guizhou, joined Guangxi troops in suppressing Yao and Zhuang; all were broken.

units.zh: 夏四月癸巳，兵部侍郎白圭督陝西諸邊，討孛來。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Vice Minister of War Bai Gui took charge of the Shaanxi frontiers to campaign against Bolai.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day guisi, Vice Minister of War Bai Gui supervised the Shaanxi frontiers and campaigned against Bolai.

units.zh: 五月丁未，免河南被災秋糧。
units.en: In the fifth month, on dingwei, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingwei, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.

units.zh: 六月丙子，孛來寇河西，官軍敗績。
units.en: In the sixth month, on bingzi, Bolai struck Hexi and the government army was beaten.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingzi, Bolai raided Hexi and government troops were defeated.

units.zh: 壬午，兵部尚書馬昂總督軍務，懷寧伯孫鏜充總兵官，帥京營軍禦之。
units.en: On renwu Minister of War Ma Ang was put in overall command; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, served as supreme commander and led metropolitan troops to the defense.
units.literal: On the day renwu, Minister of War Ma Ang was made overall director of military affairs; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, served as supreme commander and led metropolitan camp troops to resist.

units.zh: 秋七月庚子，總督京營太監曹吉祥及昭武伯曹欽反，左都御史寇深、恭順侯吳瑾被殺，懷寧伯孫鏜帥兵討平之。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengzi, the metropolitan camp eunuch Cao Jixiang and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rose in revolt; Kou Shen, left censor-in-chief, and Wu Jin, Marquis of Gongshun, were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and crushed the rebels.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day gengzi, Cao Jixiang, eunuch superintendent of the metropolitan camp, and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rebelled; Left Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen and Marquis of Gongshun Wu Jin were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and put the rebellion down.

units.zh: 癸卯，磔吉祥於市，夷其族，其黨湯序等悉伏誅。
units.en: On guimao Cao Jixiang was torn apart in the marketplace and his clan was wiped out; his followers, including Tang Xu, were all put to death.
units.literal: On the day guimao, Cao Jixiang was dismembered in the marketplace and his clan was exterminated; his partisans, including Tang Xu, were all executed.

units.zh: 丁未，免南畿被災稅糧。
units.en: On dingwei tax grain was forgiven in the disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region.
units.literal: On the day dingwei, tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.

units.zh: 庚戌，大赦，求直言。
units.en: On gengxu a general amnesty was proclaimed and the throne called for blunt memorials.
units.literal: On the day gengxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed and forthright counsel was sought.

units.zh: 丁巳，河決開封，侍郎薛遠往治之。
units.en: On dingsi the Yellow River broke at Kaifeng; Vice Minister Xue Yuan was dispatched to manage the works.
units.literal: On the day dingsi, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng; Vice Minister Xue Yuan was sent to repair it.

units.zh: 戊午，都督馮宗充總兵官，禦寇於河西，兵部侍郎白圭、副都御史王竑參贊軍務。
units.en: On wuwu Feng Zong was made supreme commander to hold the Hexi frontier; Vice Minister Bai Gui and Vice Censor Wang Hong joined in directing operations.
units.literal: On the day wuwu, Feng Zong served as supreme commander to resist the raiders in Hexi; Vice Minister of War Bai Gui and Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong assisted in military affairs.

units.zh: 辛酉，孛來上書乞和。
units.en: On xinyou Bolai sent a letter suing for peace.
units.literal: On the day xinyou, Bolai sent a letter begging peace.

units.zh: 九月壬戌，京師地震有聲。
units.en: In the ninth month, on renxu, the capital was shaken by a rumbling earthquake.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake with a sound.

units.zh: 冬十月壬申，以西邊用兵，令河南、山西、陝西士民納馬者予冠帶。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, with war on the western frontier, commoners in Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi who furnished horses were given honorary caps and sashes.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day renshen, because of warfare on the western frontier, commoners in Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi who presented horses were granted caps and sashes.

units.zh: 十一月丁酉朔，日有食之。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the new moon dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the new moon day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 壬戌，幸南海子。
units.en: On renxu the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
units.literal: On the day renxu, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

units.zh: 是年，安南、疏球中山、哈密、亦力把里入貢。
units.en: That year embassies came from Annam, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, and Ilibaliq.
units.literal: That year, Annam, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, and Ilibaliq sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順六年
units.en: The sixth year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year six.

units.zh: 六年春正月丁未，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: In the sixth year, in the first month of spring, on dingwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the day dingwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 戊申，孛來遣使入貢。
units.en: On wushen Bolai sent tribute envoys to court.
units.literal: On the day wushen, Bolai dispatched envoys bearing tribute.

units.zh: 二月癸酉，諭孛來。
units.en: In the second month, on guiyou, an edict rebuked Bolai.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day guiyou, Bolai was admonished by edict.

units.zh: 三月癸丑，召馮宗等還。
units.en: In the third month, on guichou, Feng Zong and the other commanders were recalled.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day guichou, Feng Zong and others were recalled.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申，免河南被災秋糧。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day renshen, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.

units.zh: 五月庚子，顏彪討平兩廣諸瑤。
units.en: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Yan Biao pacified the Yao rebels of the two Guang.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengzi, Yan Biao pacified the Yao of the two Guang.

units.zh: 己未，免陝西被災秋糧。
units.en: On jiwei autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.
units.literal: On the day jiwei, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.

units.zh: 六月戊辰，淮王祁銓來朝。
units.en: In the sixth month, on wuchen, the Prince of Huai, Zhu Qiquan, came to court.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuchen, the Prince of Huai, Zhu Qiquan, came to court.

units.zh: 秋七月，淮安海溢。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn the sea overflowed at Huai'an.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, the sea at Huai'an overflowed.

units.zh: 九月乙未，皇太后崩。
units.en: In the ninth month, on yiwei, the Empress Dowager died.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yiwei, the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲午，葬孝恭章皇后。
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiawu, Empress Xiaogongzhang was interred.
units.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day jiawu, Empress Xiaogongzhang was buried.

units.zh: 是年，琉球中山、哈密、烏斯藏、暹羅入貢。
units.en: That year embassies came from Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, U-Tsang, and Siam.
units.literal: That year, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, U-Tsang, and Siam sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順七年
units.en: The seventh year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year seven.

units.zh: 七年春正月丙午，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: In the seventh year, in the first month of spring, on bingwu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day bingwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 二月壬戌，詹事陳文為禮部侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。
units.en: In the second month, on renxu, Chen Wen, household tutor, was made vice minister of rites and Hanlin academician; he entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate state secrets.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day renxu, Chen Wen, Household Tutor, was made Vice Minister of Rites concurrently serving as Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.

units.zh: 三月壬寅，旱，詔行寬卹之政，停各處銀場。
units.en: In the third month, on renyin, drought brought an edict for lenient rule and the closing of silver mines throughout the realm.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day renyin, there was drought; an edict ordered lenient government and halted silver mines everywhere.

units.zh: 夏四月壬午，逮宣、大巡按御史李蕃，荷校於長安門，尋死。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on renwu, Li Fan, touring censor of Xuan and Da, was arrested, exposed in the cangue at Chang'an Gate, and soon died.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day renwu, Li Fan, touring investigating censor of Xuan and Da, was arrested; he was punished with the cangue at Chang'an Gate and before long died.

units.zh: 丙戌，復遣中官督蘇、杭織造。
units.en: On bingxu palace eunuchs were again sent to oversee Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving.
units.literal: On the day bingxu, eunuchs were again dispatched to supervise Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving.

units.zh: 五月己丑朔，日有食之。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the new moon jichou, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the new moon day jichou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 甲寅，遼東巡按御史楊璡以擅撻軍職逮治。
units.en: On jiayin Yang Jin, touring censor of Liaodong, was arrested for flogging officers without authority.
units.literal: On the day jiayin, Yang Jin, touring investigating censor of Liaodong, was arrested and punished for beating military officers on his own authority.

units.zh: 六月丁卯，逮山西巡按御史韓祺，荷校於長安門，數日死。
units.en: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Han Qi, touring censor of Shanxi, was arrested, exposed in the cangue at Chang'an Gate, and died within days.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, Han Qi, touring investigating censor of Shanxi, was arrested; he was punished with the cangue at Chang'an Gate and died after several days.

units.zh: 秋七月庚戌，免陝西被災稅糧。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Shaanxi.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day gengxu, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.

units.zh: 閏月甲戌，上宣宗廢后胡氏尊諡。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on jiaxu, posthumous honors were conferred on Xuanzong's deposed empress, Lady Hu.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiaxu, posthumous honors were raised for the deposed empress Hu of Xuanzong.

units.zh: 戊寅，命湖廣、貴州會師討洪江叛苗。
units.en: On wuyin armies of Huguang and Guizhou were ordered to join in suppressing rebel Miao at Hongjiang.
units.literal: On the day wuyin, troops of Huguang and Guizhou were ordered to unite in campaigning against rebel Miao of Hongjiang.

units.zh: 九月甲戌，敕廣東總兵官歐信會廣西兵討瑤賊。
units.en: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, an edict ordered Ou Xin, supreme commander of Guangdong, to join Guangxi forces against Yao rebels.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiaxu, an edict ordered Ou Xin, supreme commander of Guangdong, to join Guangxi troops in campaigning against Yao bandits.

units.zh: 冬十月丁酉，振西安諸府饑。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, famine relief was sent to Xi'an and neighboring prefectures.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day dingyou, famine in the prefectures of Xi'an and elsewhere was relieved.

units.zh: 丁未，巡撫廣西僉都御史吳楨節制兩廣諸軍，討瑤賊。
units.en: On dingwei Wu Zhen, grand coordinator of Guangxi and vice censor-in-chief, was given overall command of the two Guang armies against Yao rebels.
units.literal: On the day dingwei, Wu Zhen, grand coordinator of Guangxi and Vice Censor-in-Chief, took overall command of troops in the two Guang to campaign against Yao bandits.

units.zh: 十一月癸酉，賊陷梧州，致仕布政使宋欽死之。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, rebels seized Wuzhou; Song Qin, retired administrative commissioner, was killed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guiyou, bandits took Wuzhou; Song Qin, retired administrative commissioner, died in the affair.

units.zh: [2]壬午，下右都御史李賓、副都御史林聰於錦衣衛獄。
units.en: [2] On renwu Li Bin, right censor-in-chief, and Lin Cong, vice censor-in-chief, were thrown into the Brocade Guard prison.
units.literal: [2] On the day renwu, Right Censor-in-Chief Li Bin and Vice Censor-in-Chief Lin Cong were sent to the Brocade Guard prison.

units.zh: 十二月辛卯，下刑部尚書陸瑜，侍郎周瑄、程信於錦衣衛獄，尋釋之。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, Minister of Justice Lu Yu and Vice Ministers Zhou Xuan and Cheng Xin were jailed in the Brocade Guard and soon released.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinmao, Minister of Justice Lu Yu and Vice Ministers Zhou Xuan and Cheng Xin were sent to the Brocade Guard prison; before long they were released.

units.zh: 是年，琉球中山、哈密、安南、烏斯藏入貢。
units.en: That year embassies came from Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, Annam, and U-Tsang.
units.literal: That year, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, Annam, and U-Tsang sent tribute.

units.zh: 天順八年
units.en: The eighth year of the Tianshun reign.
units.literal: Tianshun year eight.

units.zh: 八年春正月乙卯，帝不豫。
units.en: In the eighth year, in the first month of spring, on yimao, the Emperor fell ill.
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on the day yimao, the Emperor was unwell.

units.zh: 己未，皇太子攝事於文華殿。
units.en: On jiwei the crown prince presided over affairs at Wenhua Hall.
units.literal: On the day jiwei, the Crown Prince handled affairs at Wenhua Hall.

units.zh: 己巳，大漸，遺詔罷宮妃殉葬。
units.en: On jisi his illness turned grave; in his testament he abolished the burial of consorts with the dead.
units.literal: On the day jisi, his illness became severe; in his testament he abolished consort burial sacrifice.

units.zh: 庚午，崩，年三十有八。
units.en: On gengwu he died, aged thirty-eight.
units.literal: On the day gengwu, he died, aged thirty-eight.

units.zh: 二月乙未，上尊諡，[3]廟號英宗，葬裕陵。
units.en: In the second month, on yiwei, posthumous titles were raised; [3] his temple name was Yingzong; he was buried at Yuling.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day yiwei, posthumous titles were elevated; [3] temple name Yingzong; he was buried at Yuling.

units.zh: 贊曰：英宗承仁、宣之業，海內富庶，朝野清晏。
units.en: The appraisal says: Yingzong took up the legacy of Renzong and Xuanzong; the realm within the seas grew rich, and court and countryside knew peace.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Yingzong inherited the work of Ren and Xuan; within the seas the realm was wealthy and court and countryside were tranquil.

units.zh: 大臣如三楊、胡濙、張輔，皆累朝勳舊，受遺輔政，綱紀未弛。
units.en: Grand ministers such as the Three Yangs, Hu Ying, and Zhang Fu were meritorious veterans of successive reigns, entrusted at the late emperor's death to guide the state, and public order had not yet slackened.
units.literal: Grand ministers such as the Three Yangs, Hu Ying, and Zhang Fu were all hereditary ministers of successive reigns who received the late emperor's testament and assisted in government; discipline was not yet slackened.

units.zh: 獨以王振擅權開釁，遂至乘輿播遷。
units.en: Yet Wang Zhen's monopoly of power opened the breach, until the imperial carriage was driven into exile.
units.literal: Only because Wang Zhen monopolized power and opened the breach did it come to the imperial carriage being driven abroad.

units.zh: 乃復辟而後，猶追念不已，抑何其惑溺之深也。
units.en: After his restoration he still dwelt on these things without end—how deep his infatuation ran!
units.literal: Yet after the restoration he still dwelt on these things without end — how deep his infatuation ran!

units.zh: 前後在位二十四年，無甚稗政。
units.en: Altogether he held the throne twenty-four years, with no grave harmful policies.
units.literal: Altogether he held the throne twenty-four years, without grave harmful policies.

units.zh: 至於上恭讓后諡，釋建庶人之繫，罷宮妃殉葬，則盛德之事可法後世者矣。
units.en: In raising posthumous honors for Empress Gongrang, freeing the Deposed Heir from his bonds, and ending consort burial sacrifice, he left deeds of great virtue that later ages may take as models.
units.literal: As for raising posthumous honors for Empress Gongrang, releasing the Deposed Heir from bonds, and abolishing consort burial sacrifice — these were deeds of great virtue that later ages may take as models.

units.zh: 進彪為侯 此系於正月，本書卷一〇七功臣世表、英宗實錄卷三〇二繫於四月己巳。
units.en: "Shi Biao advanced to marquis": here dated to the first month; this book, juan 107, Chronological Table of Meritorious Officials, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 302, place it in the fourth month on jisi.
units.literal: Shi Biao advanced to marquis — here dated to the first month; this book, juan 107, Chronological Table of Meritorious Officials, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 302, place it in the fourth month on jisi.

units.zh: 致仕布政使宋欽死之 宋欽，原作「宗欽」，據本書卷三一七潯州傳、《明史稿》紀一〇英宗後紀、《英宗實錄》卷三五九改。
units.en: "The retired administrative commissioner Song Qin died in the affair": Song Qin—the original read "Zong Qin"; emended per this book, juan 317, Xunzhou Treatise, Draft History of the Ming, Annals 10, Account of After Yingzong, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 359.
units.literal: The retired administrative commissioner Song Qin died in the affair — Song Qin: the original read "Zong Qin"; emended per this book, juan 317, Xunzhou Treatise, Draft History of the Ming, Annals 10, Account of After Yingzong, and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 359.

units.zh: 二月乙未上尊諡 二月，原作「三月」，據《英宗實錄》卷三六一、《憲宗實錄》卷二改。
units.en: Collation: the entry "second month, yiwei, posthumous titles" originally read "third month"; corrected to "second month" on the authority of the Yingzong Shilu, juan 361, and the Xianzong Shilu, juan 2.
units.literal: Second month, day yiwei, posthumous titles accorded — the original read "third month"; emended to "second month" per the Yingzong Shilu, juan 361, and the Xianzong Shilu, juan 2.
